versions.content: If the swCalibrationAccess of a VariableDataPrototype in the role ramBlock of a NvBlockSwComponentType 's NvBlockDescriptor is set to readOnly or readWrite and RteMeasurementSupport is set to true the RTE Generator shall create a McDataInstance element with • symbol set to the C-symbol name used for the allocation (see also [SWS_Rte_07174]) • flatMapEntry referencing to the corresponding FlatInstanceDescriptor element of the NvBlockSwComponentType
